invariant.name: shares_backed_by_assets
invariant.informal: The total number of shares in existence must always equal the total assets held by the vault.

rationale: In a 1:1 vault with no yield or fee mechanics, every share must be backed by exactly one unit of assets; any deviation means shares were created without corresponding assets, i.e. value from air. This invariant will be violated by the +1 bug in mintedShares.
